missing_claims.evidence: The available Cell main article gives bead architecture and Nextera XT, but defers exact primers to inaccessible Extended Procedures/Table S6. A later Dec 2015 inventor-lab protocol prints and maps primer names to Macosko et al.; Seq-Well uses the same mRNA capture beads. Those sources narrow the likely oligo family but do not prove the original Table S6 strands or sample-specific N70X index.

conclusion: Two independent readings cover the available Cell main article and later Seq-Well oligo table. The later Macosko/Goldman v3.1 original has one located reading. Original Extended Procedures/Table S6 remain unavailable; no primer-absence or exact historical identity claim is accepted.
